name: Oxpheneridine
summary: Oxpheneridine is a 4-phenylpiperidine derivative that is related to the opioid analgesic drug pethidine (meperidine).

uses.text: Oxpheneridine is not currently used in medicine.

pharmacology.en: Like pethidine it acts as an agonist at the μ-opioid receptor.
pharmacology.zh: 與配西汀一樣，它是 μ 型鴉片受體的促效劑。
pharmacology.zhHans: 与配西汀一样，它是 μ 型鸦片受体的促效剂。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its class, the opioids, cause drowsiness, nausea, constipation and slowed breathing, and an overdose can stop breathing altogether.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。它所屬的鴉片類藥物會造成嗜睡、噁心、便祕與呼吸變慢，過量時可能導致呼吸完全停止。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。它所属的鸦片类药物会造成嗜睡、恶心、便秘与呼吸变慢，过量时可能导致呼吸完全停止。

fact.en: It is one of the 4-phenylpiperidines, the family found in 1939 at the German company Hoechst while chemists were looking for a drug to relax the gut, which instead gave pethidine.
fact.zh: 它屬於 4-苯基哌啶類。1939 年德國赫斯特公司的化學家在尋找鬆弛腸道的藥物時發現了這個家族，結果意外得到配西汀。
fact.zhHans: 它属于 4-苯基哌啶类。1939 年德国赫斯特公司的化学家在寻找松弛肠道的药物时发现了这个家族，结果意外得到配西汀。
